app.name: PanelPilot
app.tagline: Diagnostic and design copilot for electrical and control engineers.

diagnosis.checkParameter: Check parameter <param>21.03</param> against the supply of <volts>400 V</volts>.

tokens.title: Design tokens
tokens.intro: Every value below resolves to a CSS custom property.

diagnosticCard.heading: Diagnosis
diagnosticCard.uncertainWithSources: There is not enough supporting evidence to give steps for this. Check the documentation below before acting.
diagnosticCard.uncertainNoSources: There is not enough supporting evidence to give steps for this. Check the equipment documentation before acting.
diagnosticCard.refusalFallback: This question could not be answered from the available documentation.

chat.empty: Describe the fault you are seeing.
chat.placeholder: e.g. ACS880 tripping on undervoltage at start

failed.heading: This answer did not finish
failed.connection-lost: The connection dropped before the answer was complete. Nothing shown is missing — there is no partial answer to read.
failed.malformed-frame: The answer arrived damaged and was discarded rather than shown in part.
failed.server-error: The server could not start this answer.

context.editLabel: Set the equipment for this session

capture.stillUploading: Still uploading — this connection is slow, not stuck.
capture.storedNoReading: The photo was uploaded, but nothing read it. Describe the fault code and it will be diagnosed as usual.
capture.pleaseConfirm: Please confirm what this shows before it is diagnosed:
capture.messageNoCode: A fault is shown on the display

verdict.not_a_fault_display: This does not look like a fault display.
verdict.unreadable: The display could not be read from this photo.

error.not-an-image: That file is not an image.
error.too-large-after-compression: The photo is too large to upload even after compression.
error.decode-failed: The photo could not be opened. Try taking it again.
error.encode-failed: The photo could not be processed on this device.
error.too-large: The server rejected the photo as too large.
error.network: The photo could not be uploaded. Check the connection and try again.
error.unavailable: Photo upload is not available right now.
error.timeout: The upload took too long and was stopped.
